verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Klaviyo includes reports in its plans, offers API data pulls for performance dashboards and analysis, and supports flow performance reports through its MCP server. None of it names the specific metrics or their granularity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions metrics, per-campaign and per-flow-step breakdowns, time-series reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
